valid_synapses_nt_v2_view.description: An inner join of the valid_synapses_nt_v2 table and the synapses_nt_v1 table. Useful for directly querying synapses that have been marked as valid from the valid_synapses_nt_v2 table. Contains all columns of the synapses_nt_v1 table. id_valid is the row id of the valid_synapses_nt_v2 table, and id is the row id of the synapses_nt_v1 table.

nt_summary_view.description: This is a view designed to let you query the likely neurotranmitter type of a root id.  It groups the valid_synapses_nt_v2_view view to group by pre_pt_root_id and returns the average and standard deviation of most of the columns.

valid_connection_v2.description: This is a summary table of synaptic connections (all synapses between two root_ids).  It joins the synapses_nt_v1 table with the valid_synapses_nt_v2 table to filter out synapses, then it groups it by the post_pt_root_id and the pre_pt_root_id, and returns the number of rows as n_syn, as well as the average value for the various neurotransmitter columns, connection_score, and cleft_score and the average value of valid_nt, interpreting false=0, true=1.  It also returns the standard deviations of those same columns with the '_std' removed.  All individual synapse information is removed, you can query the synapse table for those specific root_id combinations to get more detailed information.

valid_synapses_nt_np.description: A left join valid_synapses_nt_v2_view and fly_synapses_neuropil_v2 which adds neuropil information to valid_synapses_nt_v2_view. The id column carries the id from the synapse table.
